'''Barrin''' is a member of the [[Seanchan]] [[Deathwatch Guard]].

== History ==
Barrin stopped a man from breathing on [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]], as the man had his mouth filled with poison.

== Activities ==
Barrin is on duty, when [[Matrim Cauthon]] saves [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]]'s life from a [[Gray Man]]. He is sent to search for the Gray Man, who managed to escape in the confusion.

==Trivia==
*Barrin is named after Johnnie Lee Barrington, Jr., a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
